title: Microsoft Viva: Cowork adoption and impact in the Consumption Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard
summary: The reporting features and control routes are supported, and the briefing correctly flags conflicting export and access documentation. The licensing guidance omits the minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights service-plan licenses required for advanced analysis, which could leave analysts unable to run the recommended queries.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Licence
claims.claim: Assigned Copilot licenses include manager, leader and advanced analysis, with no minimum assigned-license qualification stated in the briefing.
claims.quote: At least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are required to access advanced analysis and the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. This minimum threshold can be achieved through a combination of licenses.
claims.fix: Append to licensing.notes and the Licence paragraph: 'For advanced analysis, including consumption queries, Microsoft requires at least 50 assigned Viva Insights service-plan licenses, which can be a combination of Copilot and Viva Insights licenses.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/environment-requirements. Do not apply this threshold to basic Copilot Dashboard access, whose own guide gives a different threshold.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Viva Insights requires applicable licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.
claims.quote: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Licence; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Consumption Dashboard guide lists access roles but names no licence.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are available to Insights Analysts with global partition access, Managers, and Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard is available to business or enterprise Microsoft 365 or Office 365 customers with an active Exchange Online account.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights is available to any customer with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 subscription for business or enterprise, and who has an active Exchange Online account.
claims.fix: After this sentence add: 'Its guide says data processing requires 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses or one assigned Copilot license, whereas the environment requirements page still states 50 assigned licenses for advanced analysis and the Copilot Dashboard.' Both URLs are already cited; keep the advanced-analysis requirement distinct from basic dashboard access.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Exported person identifiers are hashed unless an administrator enables identifiable export for the recipient.
claims.quote: Personal identifiers are available with hashed IDs, unless your administrator has enabled identifiable export for you. If your administrator has enabled identifiable export, the export also includes identifiable fields.

claims.claim: Identification VFAM policies govern named-user outputs for Consumption Dashboard insights and exports.
claims.quote:
Identification is available for the following Viva Insights features:
Consumption Dashboard data export and Consumption Dashboard insights
Access is governed by a dedicated Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) policy

claims.claim: Only Microsoft 365 Global Administrators or AI Administrators can create and manage identification policies, using either UI or PowerShell.
claims.quote: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or an AI Administrator can create and manage identification access policies. Either role can perform every step, in both the Microsoft 365 admin center and PowerShell.

claims.claim: Identification is reached in the Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Org settings > Viva feature access > Viva Insights > identification feature.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Org settings > Viva feature access, select Viva Insights, choose the identification feature, and add a policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <FeatureId> -Name <PolicyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $true creates a feature-enabling policy in Exchange Online PowerShell.
claims.quote:
Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy
-FeatureId <String>
-IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean>
-ModuleId <String>
-Name <String>
$true: The feature is enabled by the policy.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature returns the FeatureId needed by Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy.
claims.quote: To view details about the features in a Viva module that support feature access controls, use the Get-VivaModuleFeature cmdlet. The FeatureId value is returned in the output of the cmdlet.

claims.claim: Identification policies can target groups, users or the tenant.
claims.quote: VFAM lets you enable or disable specific Microsoft 365 and Viva features for chosen groups, users, or your whole tenant

claims.claim: A group or user identification policy can target up to 20 users or groups.
claims.quote: Up to 20 users/groups per policy; up to 10 policies per feature.

claims.claim: Identification permits one tenant-wide policy per feature.
claims.quote: One tenant-wide policy per feature.

claims.claim: Manager consumption access is set in the Viva Insights Admin portal through Settings > Manager settings > Grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Viva Insights Admin portal with your admin credentials.
On the left, select Settings, then Manager settings.
Optionally, select Grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights.

claims.claim: No automation operation for the manager-specific consumption-insights setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Manager settings Consumption insights PowerShell Microsoft Graph API configure access; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Viva Insights manager settings consumption insights API; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Viva Insights Grant managers scoped access Consumption insights.

claims.claim: The manager setting governs team-scoped consumption dashboard and export access, subject to the export page's narrower current role list.
claims.quote: When you select this, you'll allow managers with the minimum team size to access their team-scoped data in the Consumption Dashboard and export data.

claims.claim: Viva Insights Administrators or AI admins configure manager settings.
claims.quote: Applies to: Viva Insights Administrator, AI admin

claims.claim: Managers need teams of five or more.
claims.quote: Only managers whose team size meets or exceeds the Minimum team size setting can access insights in the Viva Insights web app. The minimum team size must be set to at least five.
claims.fix: Replace 'team of five or more' in the note and rendered table with 'team must meet the configured Minimum team size, which is at least five and includes the manager'. This preserves five as the lower bound without presenting it as every tenant's configured threshold.

claims.claim: Manager consumption-insights access also requires Copilot-insights access.
claims.quote: You can't grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights if you don't grant them access to Copilot insights.

claims.claim: Manager setting changes apply after one hour.
claims.quote: Changes to these settings will apply after one hour.

claims.claim: The most recent consumption data is available up to one to two days before the current date.

claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Underlying Cowork activities are billed on a usage basis, separate from the reporting views.
claims.quote: Cowork uses a usage-based billing model. Activities such as model responses, tool and skill calls, image generation, and browser tasks count toward your organization's consumption.

claims.claim: Users can ask their tenant admin to exclude them from analysis in the Consumption Dashboard.
claims.quote: To be excluded from analysis in the Consumption Dashboard, users can ask their tenant admin to add them to the exclusion list.
